title_en: 2026 Winter Session Internship Semester Program: Application for Field Practice in the Course "Field Practice 3" (『현장실습 3』) (Application Documents Accepted 10.26 (Mon) – 10.30 (Fri))
summary: The Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering is accepting applications for field practice in the 2026 Winter Session internship semester course "Field Practice 3" (『현장실습 3』). Application forms must be submitted by email during the first application period, 26–30 October 2026, or during a possible second period, 10–11 November 2026.
applies_to: Students interested in the 2026 Winter Session internship semester course "Field Practice 3" (『현장실습 3』).

dates.what: Application period (Round 2), which may not take place depending on the results of Round 1 selection

steps: Review the list of host organisations in Attachment 1 ([붙임1] 2026(동계) 현장실습학기제_현장실습3_실습기관.xlsx).
Complete the application form in Attachment 2 ([붙임2] 2026(동계) 현장실습학기제_현장실습3_참가신청서(한화오션).docx), using Attachment 3 ([붙임3] (한화오션) 직무별 담당 업무 소개) as a reference when writing your preferred job field.
Sign the application form at the bottom.

Submit the signed application form by email to the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering office (Building 34, Room 417) within the application period (Round 1: 26–30 October 2026; Round 2, if held: 10–11 November 2026). The contact details are in the original notice.
Register for the course "Field Practice 3" (수강신청), and check the separate notice for the course registration and tuition payment schedule, which may differ from the regular schedule.
translation:
2026 Winter Session Internship Semester Program: Application for Field Practice in the Course "Field Practice 3" (『현장실습 3』) (Application Documents Accepted 10.26 (Mon) – 10.30 (Fri))
Posted: 2026-10-22

We announce the application for field practice in the 2026 Winter Session internship semester course "Field Practice 3" (『현장실습 3』) as follows. Interested students are encouraged to apply.

"Field Practice 3" combines field practice with course enrolment, so you must register for the course (수강신청). You may not take any other Winter Session course (including online/remote courses); any other course you have already registered for will be cancelled. The course registration and tuition payment schedule may differ from the regular schedule, so you must check the separate notice.

Please note that if you withdraw from the field practice partway through or participate insincerely, no credit will be awarded and payment of the practice allowance may be restricted.

2. Schedule

3. Host organisations (※ If the table below is not visible, refer to the file "[붙임1]" (Attachment 1))

[Note from translator: The content of items 1, 2 and 3 appears to have been provided as tables or images that are not included in the text of the notice, so it was not read. The attached files were also not read.]

4. How to submit the application: by email (the application form must include your signature at the bottom)

5. Application period (deadlines strictly enforced)
 - (Round 1) 26 October 2026 (Mon) – 30 October 2026 (Fri)
 - (Round 2) 10 November 2026 (Tue) – 11 November 2026 (Wed) (※ Round 2 selection may not take place, depending on the results of Round 1 selection)

6. Submission and enquiries: Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering office (Building 34, Room 417). The contact person, email address and phone number are given in the original notice.
